dedupe_keys.name: usgs estimated annual agricultural pesticide use for counties of the conterminous us epest preliminary 2018 and 2019

description: These U.S. Geological Survey data releases give preliminary estimates of annual agricultural use of each pesticide compound by county for the conterminous United States, for 2019 and for 2018. The ScienceBase page for 2019 says USDA county harvested-crop acreage was combined with proprietary Crop Reporting District pesticide-use surveys using the methods of Thelin and Stone (2013) and Baker and Stone (2015), giving a low and a high estimate where survey data were missing, while California values come from the state Pesticide Use Reporting database; files are tab-delimited by compound, year, state and county FIPS code and kilograms. The 2019 release was published on 24 September 2021 by Christine Wieben as a text file of about 3.8 MB with XML metadata, downloadable and free (USGS data; the licence is not stated on the page read), with national coverage by county. Caveats: estimates are preliminary and may be revised with the 2022 Census of Agriculture, and low and high estimates can differ widely. For simulation it gives chemical input loads by county for water quality, drinking water intake risk and agricultural supply scenarios. Related catalogue records include the half-degree nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizer use data and the USGS subsurface tile drainage extent estimates.
